lede: The most consequential meeting this week is SMART's August 13 board session, where two resolutions restructure the Gondola Advisory Committee and assign professional contracts tied to the voter-approved $5.2M/year gondola tax — real decisions on how that money gets managed. San Miguel County Planning Commission also meets August 13 on a subdivision work session and an energy code update that would reset building standards for new construction. Later in the week, HARC takes up the unpermitted Elks Lodge pergola and preliminary large-scale review of the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road, with a site walk at 3:00 PM on August 19.

notable.stake: Board votes on resolutions restructuring gondola tax committee and assigning contracts.
County energy code update would change building standards for all new construction.
HARC decides whether to approve an unpermitted structure in the Historic Landmark District.
Preliminary large-scale review of Shandoka Lot redevelopment — multiple new buildings on Black Bear Rd.
